event: Receptionist enters the shared password on a phishing page
Attacker exports the member list from FairwayOne
First member reports a fake paybill SMS to reception
Membership and Events Manager told after the third call
DPO told; Club treated as aware of a possible breach
ICT support firm resets the reception password and ends sessions
Team tries to reach FairwayOne; no weekend contact on file
Team debates warning members; no message template; decision deferred to Monday
DPO assesses: names and phones of 1,850 members exported, fraud attempts under way; notifiable
SMS and email warning to all members with the correct paybill (about 52 hours after awareness)
Named accounts with MFA set up for reception; phishing email blocked
